user.title: Local Hikvision DVR
user.description: Read-only camera count and disk status. Use the DVR's local credentials, not your Hik-Connect account. No recording, alert or lighting settings are changed. HTTP Digest does not encrypt video or status traffic; use HTTPS with a trusted certificate when available.

reauth_confirm.title: Update local DVR credentials
reauth_confirm.description: The DVR rejected its saved local credentials. Enter the current local credentials; do not use Hik-Connect cloud credentials.

error.invalid_auth: The DVR rejected these local credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not read this DVR's ISAPI device information.
error.wrong_device: This address returned a different DVR identity. Credentials were not updated.
